typography.rationale: DM Sans has soft, approachable curves that feel friendly while remaining executive-ready, ideal for de-risking first contact with cautious buyers. Inter maintains crisp readability for metrics and service detail, supporting conversion-focused layouts and mobile CTAs.

brand_voice.voice_summary: Invite conversations with optimistic, jargon-light copy that turns complex marketing into clear next steps. Use encouraging subtext on CTAs and microcopy that reduces perceived effort for busy firm administrators and partners.

why_these_colors: Trustworthy teal grounds the brand in calm competence, while a disciplined use of coral-orange energizes CTAs and progress states for better tap-through rates. Deep navy anchors authority so the palette remains suitable for professional services. Light sky highlights provide soft emphasis for badges and notices, all while preserving AA contrast for accessibility.
